sources.decision: Layered breadth-first semantics inform FIFO depth boundaries. Bimax uses an indexed FIFO with periodic compaction after experiments; preserve its own order, missing-node and non-finite-depth behavior. No library or upstream code imported.

Considered constant-time queue ends; use a simpler indexed array with consumed references cleared and amortized compaction. No claim that Array.shift is always slow; profile wide and narrow graphs separately.

Investigate bounded selector mechanics and monotonic-prefix/ring portfolios; reject two Bimax candidates because general-input timings regress. Retain the existing production heap. References establish mechanics, not Bimax performance.
